items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Now Bob Haggart for example is going to use my bass. He didn’t want to bring one, so he’ll be using mine.

ctx.x: Do you ever go to places where they’ll provide a bass for you?

Oh I do that quite a bit. I just came off a tour of England and I happened to know the instrument I was going to use in advance, except for one, and that was a bass player whose bass was almost unplayable, so I sounded like that fifteen year old kid again. But you either pay for it by getting the instrument there, so then you’re comfortable on the bandstand, or you have it the easiest in getting there and then pay for it on the bandstand. So even if it’s somebody else’s instrument that’s good, it’s never set up…
You must have got significant classical training in the conservatory?
